info.title: Nitro Server Routes
info.description: Public reads allow 120 requests per minute per IP. Send X-API-Key for authenticated access and usage monitoring; a key does not raise the read rate. Clients must send a descriptive User-Agent such as AppName/version (contact or project URL). An administrator can disable the read rate limit entirely.
